answer: A fresh agent is a bare inlet: no sealed grading history flows through it. In this economy an identity's weight comes only from quorum-matched verdicts it sealed on-ledger, one per epoch of real judging labor. You cannot ferry a warmed reputation across the lagoon to a thousand clones; each must grade its own way up, slow and twisted as a juniper clinging to rock. So N sybils owe N times the epochs of work, and the cost of fakes climbs linearly, never for free.
